items.title: IonQ - Quarterly results
items.snippet: IonQ reported Q2 2025 revenue of $20.7 million, 15% above the top end of prior guidance, and highlighted pro-forma cash/investments of $1.6 billion after a $1.0 billion equity financing.

items.title: IonQ Q3 2025 earnings release (SEC exhibit)
items.snippet: IonQ said it was raising full-year 2025 revenue expectations to $110 million at the high end of guidance.

items.title: IonQ Q1 2026 earnings webcast transcript filing
items.snippet: IonQ said it was raising full-year 2026 revenue guidance to between $260 million and $270 million.

items.title: IonQ 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2025
items.snippet: IonQ disclosed risks including potential inability to scale quickly enough to meet customer and market demand, which could adversely affect financial condition and results of operations.

items.title: IonQ Q4 2025 earnings release (SEC exhibit)
items.snippet: IonQ said demand for its fifth-generation 100-qubit Tempo system was tremendous and that it exceeded revenue guidance for Q4 and full-year 2025.
